title: Why Do We Hiccup?
hook: A hiccup is a tiny jump in your breathing muscle.
narration: A hiccup is a tiny jump in your breathing muscle.
Air pops through and makes a hic sound.
Most hiccups stop on their own.
Sip water slowly if they hang around.
